notes.title: Patch 1.3.2 approaches you!
Patch 1.3.1 has finally arrived!
notes.content:
Notes:

Thanks to some recent feedback (and a nice and detailed e-mail from a player), I've got a new update for the game! A big thank you to everyone who has played the game!


1.3.1B addition (thanks to a request in discussion board): Added option to enable/disable 'short-jumping' in controls menu. When enabled, short-jumping allows you to control jump height by how long you hold the jump button. Barely tapping it will give you a small hop, and holding will make you jump higher. (This also currently only affects the regular player, morphing sphere and the froggy transformations.)

Fixed gamepad glitch where crouching and rapidly pressing up and jump+attack would allow for an upwards whip attack while jumping.

Changed vehicle hint text to "press activate button" so that gamepad users won't see a silly semi-colon! :P

Added extra platform on 1.4 in the hive so getting the first rocket ammo pickup will be less annoying.

Fixed glitch where sometimes falling flying enemies would get stuck and not disappear.

On Stage 5.4, I made it to where the camera in the first water area will follow the player if you fall all the way down the first pit.

For stage 6.4, I enhanced the Leaf Copter code so that rare glitches with being unable to fly do not occur. Also added a hint on how to operate the Leaf Copter.

Fixed glitch where pausing game while crouching and releasing crouch during pause leaves you still crouched upon unpausing.

Now the non-instant kill ground spikes will properly launch the player into the air each time.

Made pause menu black background transparent so you can see the player's position when the first pause menu is shown.

Some miscellaneous behind the scenes code, for possible future content.

...And most importantly now you can pet the cats in Stage 7.3! Added new achievement!

Thanks again for your support and interest. :-)

notes.title: Full version patch 1.3.0 is here!
notes.content:
Ver. 1.3.0 patch notes:

This patch mainly includes some changes to the stages, rare bug fixing and adjustments to the game's difficulty!

I have been developing this game for several years now, so it is nice to be able to reach this point!

I hope you enjoy full version 1.3.0!
